result.description:
ARA Marine, formed in 2021 and part of the ARA Group, provides speciality marine safety services technical support and engineering solutions to the commercial shipping, yacht, and offshore maritime industry in 16 major Australian ports. An employee-owned company established in 2001, ARA is comprised of the following operating divisions:

1. ARA Fire & Security 
2. ARA Electrical
3. ARA Property Services
4. ARA Products
5. ARA Marine

We provide customers with a complete range of safety and certified services and requirements. Each company’s products, services, skills and experience complement the other’s to provide clients with the timely service that is required when a ship is in port for only 24 hours

ARA Marine is seeking a talented and experienced Mechanical Engineering Technician to join their team to help support growth. 

Location: 42 Zedora Turn, Henderson, WA 6166
Full time: 38 hours per week
Salary: $95,000 per annum + Superannuation

Key Responsibilities will include:
- Prepare mechanical engineering drawings plan and technical designs under the guidance of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
- Assist in the design and development and modification of mechanical equipment and machinery
- Select appropriate tools equipment, and materials for engineering projects and maintenance activities 
- Assemble, install, test and modify mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools, control systems, and hydraulic equipment 
- Estimate material quantities, project costs, and machinery requirements to support project planning and execution
- Conduct and oversee field and laboratory testing to evaluate equipment performance and compliance
- Ensure designs, installations, and completed work comply with engineering specifications, relevant standards, regulations, and contractual requirements
- Support engineering teams by providing technical expertise throughout the design, installation, testing, and maintenance phases of projects. 

Required skills and attributes:
- Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles and practices
- Ability to read, interpret, and prepare technical drawings, plans and schematics 
- High level of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality 
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills 
- Min 1 year of experience in a related field
- Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant field  

If you meet the above criteria and you're interested in contributing to an organisation that values the highest level of quality in everything it sets out to achieve, we want to hear from you!

Apply now for this exciting opportunity to be part of the team at ARA Marine!

Job Type: Full-time
Work Location: In person
result.title: Mechanical Engineering Technician

result.description:
ABOUT US Dongara Marine is a leading company in Western Australia’s boat building and maintenance industry. With a highly experienced management team and a skilled, diverse workforce, we deliver a full range of services including new vessel construction, repairs, modifications, and ongoing support for both commercial and government clients.

Following our recent move from Dongara to our purpose-built facility in Geraldton, we are continuing to grow and are looking to strengthen our team with several key roles.

We offer:

Competitive salary –  A$77,000.00 - A$92,000.00 per year-your skills and experience will be rewarded with an attractive pay package
Job security – join a well-established and forward-thinking company with strong ongoing contracts
Work/life balance – we value our people and promote a healthy balance to ensure you perform at your best
ABOUT THE ROLE

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Marine Spray Painter to join our growing team. In this role you will be responsible for:

Examine, Prepare and mask surfaces for painting, ensuring smooth and clean surfaces. Apply, sand and shape Fairing compound.
Mix, match, and apply paints using the latest techniques and equipment.
Ensure all work is completed to a high standard of quality.
Perform paint touch-ups and minor repairs as needed.
Maintain a safe and clean work environment, following all company safety policies procedures and guidelines.
Work closely with other team members to meet insurer deadlines and client expectations.
Assist with the maintenance and upkeep of spray booths and painting equipment. (Housekeeping)
Able to follow paint specifications and documentation.
Abrasive blasting & surface preparation
Spray application using conventional & airless
Painting to specifications
Brush touch, paint/blend any defective areas of coated items.
Must have experience in applying 2K paint.
Applying vessels with anti-corrosive applications
Preparing vessel for launch
Painting of additional components for new vessels as required. ensuring a high-quality finish that meets industry standards.
ABOUT YOU:

Our ideal candidate will meet the following criteria:

Key Requirements:

Strong knowledge of paint materials, mixing, and application techniques.
Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality finishes.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication skills and a positive attitude.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Adhere to workplace safety requirements and use PPE correctly at all times.
Dongara Marine believes that its greatest asset is its people and, as an Equal Opportunity Employer, encourages applications from individuals from diverse backgrounds.
